scenes.title: Moon 7 · fine-tuned
scenes.description: An unseen simulated lunar scene after small-sample adaptation. Each future view is predicted from four observed frames and the recorded target pose.
scenes.descriptionZh: 少样本微调后的未见仿真月面场景。每个未来视野均由四帧真实观测和记录的目标位姿直接预测。
scenes.comparisonLabelZh: 真实参考 / 直接预测
scenes.autoregressiveLabelZh: 真实参考 / 自回归预测
scenes.provenance: OpenNWM Nav15 Stage 2, fine-tuned for 1,000 steps on 30 LuSNAR windows (480 target pairs). Moon 7–9 were held out. Four observed context frames; direct horizons 1–16; DDPM 250, seed 0, VAE posterior means. All 16 predictions play at 4 FPS without interpolation. Recorded capture offsets are retained in the manifest. Lunar appearance improves, but geometry and autoregressive consistency remain imperfect; this is not a physical-navigation result.
scenes.provenanceZh: OpenNWM Nav15 Stage 2，使用 30 个 LuSNAR 窗口（480 个目标对）微调 1,000 步；月面 7–9 未参与训练。四帧真实上下文，直接预测第 1–16 步；DDPM 250、seed 0、VAE 后验均值。完整 16 帧按 4 FPS 播放，无插帧；真实采集时间差保存在样例记录中。月面外观有所改善，但几何与自回归一致性仍有偏差，不能作为真实导航能力的证明。

scenes.title: The Moon
scenes.tagZh: 玉兔二号 · 真实任务
scenes.description: A real lunar observation from Chang’e-4 / Yutu-2, conditioned on a forward path.
scenes.descriptionZh: 以嫦娥四号／玉兔二号真实月面图像为起始观测，输入直行轨迹。
scenes.provenance: OpenNWM · Nav15 Stage 2 joint100k · DDPM 250 · seed 0 · VAE posterior mean. Autoregressive prediction feeds each generated image back into the model. Severe appearance drift was observed in these planetary rollouts. These are qualitative stress tests, not proof of arbitrary-scene or physical navigation capability. 16 model steps are displayed at 4 FPS; real mission capture intervals are irregular.
scenes.provenanceZh: OpenNWM · Nav15 Stage 2 joint100k · DDPM 250 · seed 0 · VAE 后验均值。自回归预测将生成图像作为后续输入；这些行星场景中观察到了严重外观漂移。这些是定性压力测试，不代表已验证任意场景或真实导航能力。16 个模型步按 4 FPS 展示；真实任务的拍摄间隔不规则。

scenes.title: A simulated Moon
scenes.description: A simulated lunar landscape from LuSNAR, evaluated with the same checkpoint.
scenes.descriptionZh: LuSNAR 仿真月面场景，使用相同模型权重测试。
scenes.provenance: OpenNWM · Nav15 Stage 2 joint100k · DDPM 250 · seed 0 · VAE posterior mean. Autoregressive prediction feeds each generated image back into the model. Severe appearance drift was observed in these planetary rollouts. These are qualitative stress tests, not proof of arbitrary-scene or physical navigation capability. 16 model steps are displayed at 4 FPS; this simulation uses normalized planar controls, without metric calibration.
scenes.provenanceZh: OpenNWM · Nav15 Stage 2 joint100k · DDPM 250 · seed 0 · VAE 后验均值。自回归预测将生成图像作为后续输入；这些行星场景中观察到了严重外观漂移。这些是定性压力测试，不代表已验证任意场景或真实导航能力。16 个模型步按 4 FPS 展示；仿真输入使用归一化平面控制，没有米制标定。

scenes.title: Recorded-path stress test
scenes.description: Conditioned on the recorded rover path, appearance drifts away from the Martian scene. Open the recorded reference to inspect the failure.
scenes.descriptionZh: 输入记录的行星车轨迹后，预测外观仍偏离火星场景。展开真实参考可查看这一失败案例。
scenes.provenance: Archived inference · 24 September 2026 · sample 4 · joint100k · DDPM 250 · seed 0. All 16 predictions are shown, without interpolation. Source intervals are irregular; playback is not real mission time.
scenes.provenanceZh: 推理归档 · 2026 年 9 月 24 日 · 样例 4 · joint100k · DDPM 250 · seed 0。完整展示 16 个预测帧，无插帧。原始拍摄间隔不规则，播放时间不代表真实任务时间。
